place.source_title: Downtown Petoskey block with a blue-painted front

brief: A row of two-storey commercial fronts: a teal-blue painted brick front with white trim and a corner bay, neighbours with awnings, parked cars. One photo. Older than 1970: Petoskey's Gaslight District (the town's model) is a row of 1880-1910 brick commercial blocks; no newer example of this main-street type exists. Foundations taken deeper than needed (spec rule 4).

facade.notes: a downtown Petoskey block (1900): a run of two-storey fronts -- a blue-painted one with a bracketed cornice, a white one, red brick -- with a coffee shop, souvenir shops, a green awning; benches, street trees, bikes on a car

why.note: a revitalised resort-town downtown (Main Street program): street trees, decorative lamps, planters, awnings
